uslaw-usc-t2-s142h:
Section 142h of Title 2 of the United States Code covers disbursement of funds for the Biomedical Ethics Board by the Library of Congress. It sits in Chapter 5 of Title 2, on the Library, current through Public Law 119-134. The authority runs from October 1, 1988 and continues thereafter.

The Disbursing Officer of the Library of Congress is authorized to do three things for the Board. The officer may disburse funds appropriated for the Biomedical Ethics Board. The officer may compute and disburse the basic pay for all personnel of the Board. The officer may also provide financial management services and support to the Board. That support is given in the same manner as for the Office of Technology Assessment under section 142f of the title.
